meta.name: Damaged 720p
meta.description:
The story begins with the disappearance of a famous painter. Soon the cops realize that his case is just the tip of the iceberg, there are numerous other young men who have gone missing and have never resurfaced. Investigations start and a suspect emerges - Lovina. This turns into an intriguing cat and mouse game between Lovina and the police, led by Abhay.

Returning Series · First aired 6 Jun 2018 · India · Language: Hindi · 20 min

Not complete. On your server: S1 15/15 | S2 not on server | S3 not on server

On your server — Audio: Hindi

videos.title: The Wall
videos.overview: A case of a missing famous painter is handed over to C.B.I. who is secretly buried in a wall by a beautiful baker.

videos.title: The Victim
videos.overview: An Urdu poet falls prey to a revengeful baker, while Crime Bureau of Investigation interrogates the key suspects of missing painter's case.

videos.title: The Trust
videos.overview: Another case of a missing writer is handed over to CBI, while Lovina birdy gathers trust among her close people.

videos.title: The Pattern
videos.overview: Dhruv Mullick gets successful in cracking a pattern of missing people, while Lovina destroys everything given to her by her ex-boyfriends.

videos.title: The backstory
videos.overview: Bijoy narrates a story of a young girl who killed her boyfriend and ran, while he captures a stalker and manages to drown him in a well.

videos.title: The Ego
videos.overview: An ego clash between Abhay and Dhruv proves fatal to Dhawre's job, while Lovina falls in love with an extremely good guy.

videos.title: The Stalker
videos.overview: Drunken Dhawre dies while saving Lovina birdy from a surprise attack of the stalker.

videos.title: The Vanisher
videos.overview: 'Vanisher' makes it to the head-lines and Inspector Meenaxi Reddy joins CBI's team.

videos.title: The Perfect Guy
videos.overview: DIG trusts Dhruv over Abhay and allows him to lead the case, while Lovina gets bored by Apurv's good boy image.

videos.title: The Backfire
videos.overview: The perfect guy meets a dead end, while Dhruv and Meenaxi manage to connect 'Desire' bakery to their individual investigations.

videos.title: The Fear
videos.overview: Abhay and Dhruv reach Lovina's house through their personal investigations. Bijoy gets scared but the death of father patrick and lust for Lovina, makes him stay.

videos.title: The Trap
videos.overview: Lovina is called to Police station for the case of missing Rohan, while Rohan is kidnapped by the Stalker. Dhruv's growing ego clashes with his team mates, while Abhay increases proximities with lovina.

videos.title: Keep Your Enemies Closer
videos.overview: Dhruv is sure about Lovina's involvement and does a thorough research on her, while Meenaxi traces Rohan and comes to know about the stalker, Neil Bhatt.

videos.title: The Revelation
videos.overview: The cake delivered to a customer from Desire bakery comes with a finger, which happens to be of Dhawre. DIG gives case back to Abhay, which fuels Dhruv with anger and revenge. He digs more and finds out truth about Neil bhatt.

videos.title: Game Over?
videos.overview: Everything boils down to Lovina Birdy. Abhay and Dhruv reach Lovina's house to save her but the confusion kills dhruv and the fear of getting caught kills Abhay. Lovina, the Vanisher survives.
